lessons: Page 28 is drawing J-46 アーチリブ（その5）, 縮尺 図示, S=1:30; the number is in the rightmost title block cell. Segment 5 runs JU4 to JU5.

Segment 5 callouts: 1-TOP PL 1700x26x9683 and 2-RIB PL 220x22x9673 (top); 1-BOTT PL 1574x26x9558 with ribs 2-RIB 220x22x557, 4-RIB x1015, 2-RIB x3607, 2-RIB x555 (bottom); 2-WEB PL 1343x23x9676 plus 220x22 web ribs numbered 2-11 (lengths 1769, 585, 496, 1939, 483, 773, 925, 920, 245, 243). All SM490YB.

Axis length is the dimension labelled 9620.4 (アーチリブ軸線上) on the web view; it also appears on the 配置図 between JU4 and JU5. The plate lengths 9683, 9676 and 9558 and the top view dimension 9682.6 are not the axis length.
Depth is constant in this segment: the D15~D18 section shows 1250 overall and 1200 web height (3@400=1200), so there is no taper. The web plate is 1343 wide only because it is curved.
Web rib list items carry a piece count prefix (4-RIB, 3-RIB, 1-RIB). Web items 2-7 are 4-RIB, 8-9 are 3-RIB and 10-11 are 1-RIB. The flange rib lists are separate and each sits beside its own view.
The 配置図 arc lengths run in order along the arch: 11070.2, 6351.7, 8003.2, 8190, 9620.4, 8186.8, 8019.6, 6341.7, 11070. This sheet's segment is the 9620.4 one, so match it by its JU labels.
Flange thickness drops along the arch (38, 38, 28, 26) and the thickness and material vary per sheet, so read each sheet's callouts.
